standard_prerequisites.name: Noether-Lefschetz and parity obstruction
standard_prerequisites.statement: For the author very-general complete-intersection surface, the cited Noether-Lefschetz theorem gives Pic generated by O(1). The PartI phi map sends a geometrically integral even-genus curve to1 and the hyperplane class of odd genus to0. The exact author degree/genus computation and all subsequent construction are supplied.

standard_prerequisites.name: Euler-characteristic specialization
standard_prerequisites.statement: The author explicitly uses the PartI even-genus/intermediate-index equivalence and specializes a coherent sheaf with odd Euler characteristic to the special fiber. The full local author mechanism2691-2695 is supplied; no new proof, normalization or extra hypothesis is added.

core_obligations: Keep delta divisibleby4 and delta>=8, exact Puiseux field and ambient P4
Retain the very-general F2/Noether-Lefschetz choice, conjugate-component intersection and smoothing construction

Do not assert the corresponding real-number existence question is solved
proof_roadmap: Choose a Fermat hypersurface and a very-general second equation so the intersection surface has cyclic Picard group and only odd-genus hyperplane generator.
Form a real hypersurface as the product of two conjugate equations whose intersection is that surface.
Any geometrically irreducible even-genus curve in the special fiber would lie in the intersection, contradicting the parity obstruction.
Smooth over real Puiseux series and transfer the obstruction using coherent Euler-characteristic specialization.
difficulty_reason: H2: this is a nonroutine explicit geometric counterexample combining a very-general Noether-Lefschetz/Picard constraint with a conjugate-component degeneration and a coherent Euler-characteristic specialization obstruction. The original construction and invoked local specialization mechanism are supplied. Its targeted obstruction differs from the K3 EPT and bielliptic signs examples; its short length does not make it a routine definition exercise.
